div.head: Northu 4
div.ab: Gif preost biscopes agen geban forbuge, gilde XX ór.
Gif preost biscopes agen geban forbuge, gilde XX or.
If a priest neglects the bishop’s own summons, he is to pay 20 ores.
If a priest disregards a bishop’s own decree, he is to pay twenty oras.
Wenn ein Priester eine Vorladung, [die] vom Bischof selbst [kommt], nicht befolgt, zahle er 20 Ör.
If a priest disobeys a summons [coming] from the bishop himself, let him pay 20 ores.
div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest neglects the the bisphop's own summons, he is to pay 20 ores.’).
